text.aria-label: Title text 'Follow-up figure D: B0 and L1 are too narrow: too many hours fall outside their 10% and 90% quantiles'
text.tspan: Follow-up figure D: B0 and L1 are too narrow: too many hours fall

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'The forecasts are out-of-fold: each is made by an XGBoost model that never trained on that month, with whole blocks of months (folds) held out in turn. The forecasts are at lead-day 1, for the day after the day of issue, from one training run (fitting seed), over all 18 scored months. A calibrated forecast has, say, 10% of hours at or below its 10% quantile. Dashed line: a calibrated forecast. Above the dashed line the quantile is too high, and below the dashed line the quantile is too low. All rows are post hoc: written after the first run's results were known. Arms. B0: the baseline with no lag. L1: B0 plus the power at the same hour on the latest whole day before the forecast was issued (two days before the target day for a day-ahead forecast).'
text.tspan: The forecasts are out-of-fold: each is made by an XGBoost model that never trained on that month, with whole blocks
of months (folds) held out in turn. The forecasts are at lead-day 1, for the day after the day of issue, from one
training run (fitting seed), over all 18 scored months.
A calibrated forecast has, say, 10% of hours at or below its 10% quantile. Dashed line: a calibrated forecast.
Above the dashed line the quantile is too high, and below the dashed line the quantile is too low.
All rows are post hoc: written after the first run's results were known.
Arms. B0: the baseline with no lag. L1: B0 plus the power at the same hour on the latest whole day before the
forecast was issued (two days before the target day for a day-ahead forecast).
